opening.argument: The video presents Goldman Sachs’ 10,000 Small Businesses program through business education, planning, skills, capital, and networking. It is described as “providing greater access to business education, financial capital and business support services,” and a speaker explains that it helps participants “to write that business plan and to be disciplined.” The 26% revenue increase and target to double sales are reported by a participant about her own business after graduating, not offered to viewers as a guaranteed investment return. The business-education imagery reinforces that instructional context. Taken together, the material describes a business-support program and a participant’s experience; it does not show a deceptive solicitation or require viewers to make a transaction.

citations.quote: providing greater access to business education, financial capital and business support services
to write that business plan and to be disciplined
Our revenues have increased 26% since I graduated, and we're on target to double our sales for the next year.
